title: Procreate Fashion Brushes
author: artbylin
description:
This pack contains a Procreate brushset to aid your fashion design/ digital fashion illustration process. Procreate is a popular drawing app for iPad. The brushes include stitching, buttons, zipper, knit etc., which are commonly applicable trims/construction details for clothing.
————————————————————————
2 FOLDERS + 1 BRUSHSET FILE + 1 VECTOR FILE:
– ‘TRIMS.BRUSHSET’ : Procreate Brushes. Save to iPad Files, open Brush Library in Procreate and import
– ‘ZIP PULLS’ FOLDER: 6 types of Zip Pulls in PNG format (monochrome line drawing + silver + gold finish)
– ‘BUTTONS’ FOLDER: Buttons in PNG format
– ADOBE ILLUSTRATOR FILE containing Zip Pulls and Buttons
